metaTitle: Hot Tub Pads: Hamilton's 2026 Award Winner
metaDescription: Hot Tub Pads won Hamilton's 2026 Concrete award for spa foundations. See its 32 MPa reinforced pads, two-day installs and 2-year warranty terms.
summary: Hot Tub Pads is Ontario's specialist for hot tub and swim spa foundations, pouring custom concrete pads, gravel bases and swim spa platforms across Hamilton, London, Kitchener and Woodstock. Most installations are completed within two days.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: Hot Tub Pads focuses narrowly on foundations for hot tubs and swim spas rather than general residential concrete or landscaping, offering custom concrete pads, swim spa pads and gravel-based alternatives. Concrete pads are poured at 32 MPa strength with rebar or wire mesh reinforcement over a compacted crushed-gravel sub-base, a mix and preparation standard aimed specifically at supporting the concentrated weight of a filled spa. This specialization means the company's process is built around one job done well rather than a broad range of concrete services.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company completes most installations within two days, a fast turnaround for a poured concrete foundation, and backs every pad with a 2-year workmanship warranty. The compacted crushed-gravel sub-base beneath each pad is intended to prevent settling under the sustained, concentrated weight of a hot tub or swim spa, which is heavier per square foot than typical patio loads. A gravel-only option is also available for homeowners who do not need a full concrete pour.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer described a perfectly level pad poured in a single day, saying the crew knew exactly what their spa installer needed and calling the finish rock solid.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: Hot Tub Pads serves Hamilton, London, Kitchener and Woodstock. Homeowners outside this footprint should confirm coverage before booking a pad installation.

strengths: Specializes specifically in hot tub and swim spa foundations rather than general concrete work.
Uses 32 MPa concrete with rebar or wire mesh reinforcement, built for concentrated spa loads.
Most installations are completed within two days.
considerations: A narrow specialty means this is not the contractor for a driveway or general patio pour.
Only one published review was available at the time of research, so ask for recent local references.
Concrete pouring is weather-dependent, so scheduling can shift around rain or freezing temperatures.
bestFor: Homeowners installing a new hot tub or swim spa
Anyone needing a fast, reliably level spa foundation
Projects requiring a reinforced pad rather than a basic gravel base
Hamilton, London, Kitchener and Woodstock homeowners planning a spa delivery
questionsToAsk: Does my spa's weight and dimensions require a concrete pad, or would gravel be sufficient?
What is the sub-base preparation before the concrete is poured?
How long should the pad cure before the spa can be placed on it?
What does the 2-year workmanship warranty cover if the pad settles or cracks?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means Hot Tub Pads was selected as the top business in the Concrete Finishing & Pouring category for Hamilton through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Do they pour driveways or patios too?
faq.a: No. The company's listed services are specifically custom concrete pads, swim spa pads and gravel hot tub pads, focused on spa foundations rather than general concrete work.
The company completes most installations within two days, according to its listed service description.

faq.q: Is gravel or concrete better for a hot tub pad?
faq.a: The company offers both, and the right choice depends on the spa's weight, ground conditions and budget, which is worth discussing directly with the installer.
